statement: The proportion of SUID cases with postpartum depression differs among groups identified by child neglect and abuse.
rationale: A case-only analysis can compare proportions or odds within the case series to identify associations between postpartum mental health status and characteristics recorded in the ncfrp_v51 dataset.
prior_art: SUID_manuscript_v9_clean.C13 suggests future research on understanding long-term consequences of separation from the mother, but does not address maternal mental health directly. bedsharing_ms_v7.C17 discusses observational data limitations without addressing postpartum mental health status.
cannot_establish: The design cannot establish causation or estimate incidence rates due to the lack of a denominator source.
